name: core-config
description: Python auto-format + cross-platform notifications + per-prompt behavioral block (`prompt_inject.sh`, shared Claude + Codex). The block is fixed; two pointers are conditional — `.llmwiki/insight/` when a knowledge root resolves in cwd, and a one-line `[council]` delegation reminder when a second-model CLI (codex / agy) is on PATH. The council line is Claude-only (Codex is itself a council member) and names the CLI roster, never a model. Work guidelines live in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (English source of truth; `.ko` companion is not loaded).

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-format-python.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/notify_osc.py" Claude "Task completed"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/notify_osc.py"; fi
